facts.fact: Radio Tamazuj reports the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Bill 2025, building on the 2021 Provisional Order, was moved to its third reading in the Transitional National Legislative Assembly on Thursday 23 October 2025.

SSD.note: Nothing on a data protection law.
Nothing on a data protection law, treaty or authority.
Consultations and workshops are not said to have run online.

facts.fact: The South Sudan Human Rights Defenders Network and CEPO publicly criticised the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Bill 2025 on 23 October 2025, warning of vague false-information offences and demanding a public hearing.

Acting information committee chair Natalina Amjima Malek told the Assembly on 23 October 2025 that the committee held public consultations and workshops, supported by UNESCO and UNMISS, on the Cybercrime and Computer Misuse Bill.

SSD.note: CEPO says a public hearing is still owed before the third reading.
A committee chair says the bill aligns with the Malabo Convention; no signature, ratification or giving effect stated.
